items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: It's a Phil band. He slept so much, soon he'd get on his job and go to sleep. Tune up and go right to bed. And I get up.

ctx.x: Yeah. And this boy, Willie San Diego, was pretty good too. Uh-huh. It's a Phil band. He slept so much, soon he'd get on his job and go to sleep. Tune up and go right to bed. And I get up.
I used to hear a lot of music around the streets, you know, vendors and people selling things. Did they all sing or play or anything?
